tasks.name: Framing
tasks.description: Erect the structural wood or steel frame of the building, including walls, floor joists, and roof trusses, up to a point where trades can begin rough-in work

tasks.name: Electrical Rough-in
tasks.description: Run wiring through the framed walls and ceilings, install electrical boxes, and set up circuit runs before walls are closed up

tasks.name: Panel Install
tasks.description: Mount and wire the main electrical breaker panel, connecting it to the rough-in circuits run throughout the structure

tasks.name: Electrical Test
tasks.description: Test all wiring circuits and the breaker panel for continuity, correct voltage, and code compliance before the branch is considered complete

tasks.name: Plumbing Rough-in
tasks.description: Install supply lines and drain, waste, and vent piping through the framed structure before walls and floors are closed

tasks.name: Pressure Test
tasks.description: Pressurize the newly installed supply and drain lines to check for leaks and verify the plumbing system holds pressure to spec

tasks.name: Fixture Rough-in
tasks.description: Install the rough-in components for sinks, tubs, toilets, and other fixtures so finish plumbing can be connected later

tasks.name: Form Flatwork
tasks.description: Build and set wooden or metal forms for flatwork areas such as the garage floor, driveway, and walkways, ensuring proper grade and alignment

tasks.name: Pour Concrete
tasks.description: Pour concrete into the prepared forms and screed it level, working the surface to remove air pockets before it begins to set

tasks.name: Cure and Finish
tasks.description: Allow the poured concrete to cure fully, then apply finishing work such as troweling, sealing, and edging to complete the flatwork

tasks.name: MEP Inspection
tasks.description: Conduct the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing inspection against code once all three independent trade branches have fully completed, this task cannot start until every branch reports its final output
